clips.title: The story
paras: Goblins are diminutive, cunning humanoids originating from the Isle of Kezan, renowned across Azeroth for their relentless pursuit of profit, explosive engineering, and aggressive trade cartels. While most maintain a stance of strict neutrality to maximize commerce between the Alliance and Horde, mercenary and cutthroat outfits like the Venture Company and Steamwheedle Cartel leave an indelible mark on every corner of the world.

Goblins hail from the Isle of Kezan in the South Seas, where their society long ago divided into competing economic syndicates known as cartels. Rather than building kingdoms or armies of their own, goblin leaders channeled their ambitions into cutthroat mercantilism, volatile engineering, and industrial ventures that now reach every corner of the world.
